hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer views their current LBG coin balance and directly applies accumulated value as a statement credit toward bill reduction.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview on mobile to check current accumulated LBG coins and evaluate progress toward bill reduction.
hypotheses.storyTension: Ensuring the available balance translates transparently to guaranteed bill reduction without unnecessary gamified clutter.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer effortlessly verifies the balance and accesses direct statement credit redemption options.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of points value and direct access to payment-linked statement credit redemption.
prohibitedDetours: Promoting experiential vouchers or partner retail deals
completionSignals: Customer taps statement credit redemption option

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: The customer reviews progress on their savings and spending goal to align automatic reward allocation with upcoming expenses.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Customer wants to check how their current points and automated allocations contribute to their active holiday spending target.
hypotheses.storyTension: Confirming that the ongoing reward allocation effectively supports the specific financial target at guaranteed rates.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Customer observes clear milestone progress and confirms the automated allocation settings.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear tracking of goal progress linked to guaranteed payment utility.
